case.summary: Case HHG-004 covers a online $128.33 transaction 3583227 on card C08106-K1 raised by a customer_report trigger. Graph investigation found 5 corroborating signal(s) - new device, amount outlier, 48h burst, shared-device ring, prior fraud on this card. Pattern assessed as card not present new device; fraud probability 0.83 before additional evidence and 0.98 after, giving a verdict of fraud. Exposure across 12 transaction(s) is $1167.02. Independent graph signals corroborate the finding, so the actions below follow from the policy routes shown with each one.

sar.narrative: On 1970-01-18 at 03:56:16, card C08106-K1 held by customer C08106 was used for a online transaction of $128.33 in billing region unknown. The cardholder reported the purchase as unauthorised in the customer_report trigger for case HHG-004, stating they did not make it. It arrived from device profile DP-9e2800d0df1d61a4, recorded as New and serving 6 card(s) across 6 customer(s). Card C08106-K1 already had 209 online authorisation(s) in the preceding 48 hours. The purchase itself is outside the cardholder's normal profile: $128.33 against a card median of $27.73. Card C08106-K1 is already named in confirmed-fraud closed case(s) CC-1736, CC-2121, CC-3778. Device profile DP-9e2800d0df1d61a4 also appears on confirmed-fraud case(s) CC-0055, CC-0197, CC-0625 involving other cards, indicating a common actor. Card(s) C02222-K1, C03095-K2, C04248-K2, C05031-K2 share that device profile and are placed under monitoring. The activity is assessed as card not present new device under policy R6. Total unauthorised amount across 12 transaction(s) is $1167.02 between 1970-01-17 and 1970-01-18. Card C08106-K1 is recommended for blocking and reissue, an internal case is opened, and the report awaits fraud-manager approval.
